The Complete Builder Kit gives you all six blueprints and seven templates for $197. Deploy your own stack. Own your commerce infrastructure.

content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy offer convenience until they suspend your account. They control your customer data, your product delivery, and your payment processing. You are renting infrastructure. Sovereign commerce stacks flip this model. You host on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders store in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files deliver via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments verify through NOWPayments with 0.5% fees and no KYC. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates. You deploy in 48 hours. You own the stack. No platform can suspend you. No geography can block you. This is infrastructure sovereignty. Not a workaround. A permanent architecture.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal block Bangladesh outright. Local gateways impose arbitrary restrictions. Conventional platforms depend on these payment processors. They fail you by design. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this dependency. NOWPayments accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC. Buyers do not need accounts. Transactions confirm on-chain. You receive payment directly to your wallet. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10. This is not a compromise. It is superior architecture for your context. Geographic gatekeeping becomes irrelevant. Your audience pays. You deliver. No platform stands between you.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction. They hold funds for days or weeks. Sovereign stacks cut this bloat. NOWPayments charges 0.5%. Crypto transactions confirm in minutes. You receive payment directly. No intermediaries. No hidden fees. The Complete Builder Kit costs $197 one time. You deploy all six stacks. You own them forever. No subscriptions. No revenue share. Compare this to renting a platform that can suspend you at any time. The real cost of conventional platforms is not their fees. It is their control over your commerce. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this cost. You pay once. You own forever.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates geographic gatekeeping. Own your stack. Bypass restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data. They control your product delivery. They can suspend your account without warning. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Your storefront code lives on GitHub or Cloudflare. Your customer list stores in Supabase or Google Sheets. Your product files deliver from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation runs on Workers or Apps Script. COREMERCH deploys the stack for you or provides blueprints for self-deployment. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. You own the infrastructure. You control the automation. You deliver the products. This is not a service. It is architecture. Built for creators who choose ownership over renting.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you sell digital products in Bangladesh and cannot use Stripe or PayPal, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your only viable architecture. The Complete Builder Kit gives you all blueprints and templates for $197. Deploy Stack 01 for a simple setup or Stack 02 for advanced features. If you need immediate deployment, COREMERCH deploys your stack in 48 hours. If you prefer self-deployment, the blueprints provide step-by-step instructions. Choose based on your technical skill and time availability. The outcome is the same: you own your commerce infrastructure. No platform controls you. No geography blocks you. This is the architecture digital creators in restricted regions need. Not a workaround. A permanent solution.

Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives digital creators in Bangladesh full ownership of their storefront, customer data, and payment processing. It bypasses geographic restrictions by using crypto payments with no KYC. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates for $197. Deploy on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or self-host. Payments process through NOWPayments with 0.5% fees. Recommended networks like BSC and Solana keep transaction costs under $0.10. This architecture eliminates platform suspension risk and geographic gatekeeping. You own the stack. You control the commerce.

Own your infrastructure. No platform controls you.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I have no technical skills?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes deployment templates and step-by-step blueprints. COREMERCH also offers deployment services for $97 or $197, depending on the stack. You do not need technical skills to own sovereign commerce infrastructure.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON. Transactions cost under $0.10. Your customers do not need accounts. Payments confirm on-chain automatically.
Can platforms suspend my sovereign stack?
No. You host on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or self-host. Your backend runs on Workers or Apps Script. Your data stores in Supabase or Google Sheets. No platform controls your stack. You own it.
How do I deliver products after payment?

Product files store in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment confirmation triggers automatic delivery via webhook. The system sends download links to customers instantly. You control the delivery process.
What happens after I deploy the stack?

You own the infrastructure. COREMERCH has no access. You manage your storefront, customer data, and payments. You can scale the stack as your business grows. This is permanent architecture, not a temporary workaround.
